```http
GET {{BASE_URL}}/processing/{{processingId}}/state
Authorization: Bearer {{customerToken}}
HTTP 200
[Asserts]
jsonpath "$.state" == "readyForDelivery"
jsonpath "$.legs" count > 0
jsonpath "$.assignee" not exists
jsonpath "$.issue" not exists
```
